Subject: MSA and onboarding sequencing — suggested approach

Kimberly / Marissa,

Thanks again for the product tour last week. Procurement here has asked to run a quick legal redline with our counsel and then a separate technical onboarding/SSO session with our infra team before we sign. To keep calendar friction low, we were hoping Redwood could offer a two-part session (legal redline then technical onboarding) either back-to-back or on consecutive mornings.

Our constraints: our counsel (Sana) is only available in the afternoons PST (post 1pm), and our infra folks prefer mornings PST. Would Redwood be able to accommodate a split day (legal 1–2pm, tech 9–10am) or two days?

I attached our annotated MSA (Crestline_MSA_redline_v2.docx) and a draft onboarding agenda. Happy to be flexible on timing — want to understand who from your side needs to be present for each session.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the redlines. Splitting the work makes sense and should reduce the amount of time counsel needs to sit through technical detail. Proposed options from our side: 

1) Same-day split: Technical onboarding 9:00–10:00am PST; Legal redline 1:00–2:00pm PST (we'll keep legal to 60 minutes, agenda-driven).
2) Two half-days: Technical 9:00–10:30am PST (walkthrough + quick run of SSO), Legal 1:00–2:30pm PST next day (more time for clause walkthrough).

Attendees we'd plan to include: Jonas Weber (Legal enablement lead) + Marissa (Customer Success) for legal session; Ben Carter (Solutions) + me for technical. If you need any other internal folks (e.g., infra leads), let me know.

Can you confirm which option you prefer and whether the suggested windows work for Sana / your infra? If option 1 is fine we'll send calendar invites for the same day with two separate events.

Thanks — K
